summary: Operator site + parkwith.us engine read today: 47 sites, 20/30/50 A, water+sewer, pull-throughs to 80 ft, showers/laundry/WiFi, open year round, holiday 2-night minimum, GS Park. Fees $35-60 -> $40-60: the $35 CreekSide sites are capped at 20 ft (not a real night for a 23-ft motorhome); the cheapest site EKKO fits is a $40 boondocking site (no hookups), $45 with water/electric. Not waterfront kept; pin is on the RV loops.
flags: PRIVATE GATE: passes. Cheapest real RV night for a 23-ft motorhome: $40 boondocking (no hookups, 40-ft max, 2-night cap) or $45 30-amp water/electric (parkwith.us, 17-18 Nov 2026; rates page undated but on the live 2026 site). The $35 'CreekSide (electric only) ... For tents, small travel trailers or sprinter vans' sites R/T/X/Y carry max_length 20 on the engine, so they don't count. Good Sam Park ('We are a preferred Good Sam Campground!'). Presence: working website + booking engine + phone 785-636-5321. Google Maps 4.6 (357 reviews) - read 2026-11-06. Long-stay: nightly rates posted and sold online; weekly/monthly by phone only; no sign of residents - passes all five tests.

WATERFRONT not waterfront kept: on Esri imagery the RV loops sit in the open field south of the railroad, the stored pin on them; Mill Creek (~25-40 m wide here) runs along the south edge behind a 30-50 m wooded band. The only creek-named class (CreekSide) is the 20-ft electric-only sites, which EKKO doesn't fit. No lead.
PIN 39.0641,-96.1754 is on the RV loops - keep. (Google's pin 39.0652,-96.1701 is the office/entrance by the tracks ~470 m east.)
PHONE 785-636-5321 and WEBSITE https://www.millcreekcampground.com/ confirmed. Booking engine https://parkwith.us/camps/mill-creek-campground (written to booking.url).
